columns.name: COMMUNICATION_ID
columns.description: Unique Id for identifying the communication message

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Id of transaction for which the communication is for

columns.name: COMMUNICATION_DATA
columns.description: Communication data in Json format

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: Guid of the user to whom the communication is intented.

columns.name: MODULEIDENTIFIER
columns.description: Module Identifier of the process related to what communication is sent

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Process Id of the process related to what the communication is intented to.

columns.name: SUBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Subject code related to message being sent.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Object code related to the message being sent.

columns.name: SUBJECT
columns.description: Name of the component which triggered the notification

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the component which triggered the notification.

columns.name: MESSAGE_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: Correlation id sent by the triggering component to identify the message record.

columns.name: MESSAGE_EXPIRATION_TIME
columns.description: Message Expiration time which will determine the life time of the message.

columns.name: OBJECT
columns.description: Name of the object which is getting modified and related to what communication is sent

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Id of the primary key of the object row related to which the communication is sent out

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the communication. It will have values like pending completed failed etc

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the enterprise for filtering the records.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: IS_MSG_GETTING_PURGED
columns.description: Flag to indicate if communication message is a candidate for getting purged.

columns.name: MESSAGE_HEADER
columns.description: Indicates the header of the message to be shown in the auditing ui.
